A blank Quarto document with R. `quarto preview` renders it again on every
save and the page reloads itself.

```{r}
#| include: false
# r/log.r: a line in the app log on every render.
box::use(./r/log)
log$log_info("rendering index.qmd")
```

```{r}
set.seed(1)
x <- rnorm(500)
summary(x)
```

```{r}
#| fig-height: 3
hist(x, breaks = 30, main = "500 draws from a normal distribution", xlab = "x")
```
